scheme_name: Incentive to Owners of A.I. Born Female Calf through Pure Breeding in Indigenous Cow Across the State
other_conditions: One person per family can avail the benefit once a year for one female calf
The female calf must be born through Artificial Insemination by pure breeding in indigenous cow
benefits_summary: ₹3,000 per female calf; one person per family eligible once a year.
